# US Consumer Sentiment Falls as Inflation Expectations Rise

The University of Michigan’s consumer sentiment index fell to 47.8 in early September 2026, down for a second consecutive month and well below market expectations of 51.0, according to the preliminary estimate.

It was the weakest reading since May’s record low.
